Justiciar Crusader Nightmist is a high elf character found in the Cloister of Sombre Embrace.

Involvement

Nightmist is a Justiciar Crusader for  Shar and possesses respectable combat prowess.

Combat

Nightmist uses  Subsume Shadow to enter her  Umbral Form, empowering her attacks with an extra 1d8⁠⁠Necrotic and making her immune to non-magical damage. This lasts until death. Although the Umbral Form passive grants an extra attack, this does not stack with Nightmist's existing  Extra Attack.
